Campground found on imagery/OSM ~480 m east of the pin, in woods 155-220 m from the lake: recommend lakeview -> not waterfront. Dyrt (aggregator) says sites fit RVs up to 22 ft. No fees found.

No tents allowed at this time' reads as a general campground. Under the separation rule this needs a phone answer (859-339-5893) if AWH wants certainty.

CRITERIA - rig size: The Dyrt (aggregator) 'Sites accommodate RVs up to 22 feet, though low-hanging branches can complicate maneuvering for larger rigs' - not an operator figure; a 2019 review only mentions low branches. Unclear -> keep with a caveat in the note (suggest: 'Low branches on the camp lane; an aggregator lists RVs to 22 ft - call ahead.').
